曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
texts.en:
The surface of [from.GetName] has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.

No trace remains of the planet's once-thriving biomes. Only extremophile life forms can still call this place home.
